usageNotes: Use this endpoint to retrieve the full CRUSH tree of OSDs on a Ceph cluster as seen from the specified node. Requires either Sys.Audit or Datastore.Audit on the root path. The queried node must be online and have Ceph configured; the response reflects cluster-wide OSD state, not just local disks.

examples.summary: List all OSDs and their CRUSH tree from node pve1

tips: The 'root' object is a recursive CRUSH bucket tree; walk 'children' arrays to enumerate individual OSDs (type == 'osd') vs. host/rack buckets.
The 'flags' field is absent entirely when no cluster-level OSD flags (e.g. 'noout', 'norebalance') are set — treat its absence as an empty flag set.
OSD health properties such as 'status', 'in', 'weight', and latency fields appear at the leaf level but are not statically typed — expect additionalProperties.
Can be called against any online Ceph mon node in the cluster; you do not have to target the node that owns a specific OSD.
